title: BJP workers protest in Belagavi against police cases over voter deletion complaints
seoTitle: Belagavi BJP protest over voter roll cases

tea.why: Police registered cases against BJP workers who filed objections and Form 7 requests about alleged fake voters during the roll revision.
tea.want: Withdraw the cases; let election officials, not police, examine complaints about voters.
tea.changed: Oct 3: BJP workers led by MLA Abhay Patil protested and handed a memorandum to the police commissioner.

summary: BJP workers led by Belagavi South MLA Abhay Patil protested in Belagavi on October 3 against police cases filed against party workers who had objected to what they called fake voters in the electoral rolls during the Special Intensive Revision. Party leaders submitted a memorandum to the city police commissioner. Patil said complaints about voters should be examined by election officials, not the police, and accused the police of filing fabricated cases under pressure from the Congress government. In Ballari, a BJP booth-level agent faces two FIRs over alleged misuse of Form 7 after seeking verification of 7,561 voters; the BJP says it only sought verification and denies targeting any community.
demands: Withdraw police cases against BJP workers
Leave voter-eligibility complaints to election officials
response: No response from the police or state government is reported in these sources.

updates.text: BJP workers protested in Belagavi and submitted a memorandum to the police commissioner.
The BJP stepped up protests over cases against its workers in Ballari and Belagavi.
